messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — opened PR that touches routing and session KV handling. This is gated on the architecture RFC so we need a design/arch review before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/4321 RFC: https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/987654321/low-latency-routing-rfc Please focus on fallback semantics and cache interaction.

alex: skimmed the changes — mostly small and readable. Main worry is fallback when a preferred variant is saturated; I think the RFC covers the intent but a couple edge cases feel underspecified. Added inline comment in PR. :thinking_face:

sam: FYI I authored the RFC. Good call on the fallback case, alex — I intentionally left the strict ordering flexible, but we should be explicit about KV-cache isolation across variants. I left a comment on PR asking for a unit/integration test for same-session cache behavior.

jules: Can we get signoff from eng-runtime arch? @alex @sam can you both review and approve once comments addressed? We shouldn't merge until RFC status is marked "Design-reviewed / Accepted". :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll take a deeper pass this afternoon. If CI is green and Sam's test lands, I'm 👍 to approve.

sam: Left one more tiny comment about naming; otherwise fine to approve after tests. Also suggest adding a short section in the RFC about canary rollout constraints.

maya: Good call. Canary rollout should be limited to Dedicated capacity pools only — avoids noisy neighbor issues. Added a short config snippet to the PR for the rollout policy: 

```yaml
rollout:
  mode: canary
  target: dedicated
  percent: 10
  duration: 2h
```

deploy-bot: CI: linux/unit ✅, linux/integration ✅, arm64/integration ❌ — failing on kv_cache_integration_test. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/job/4321/console

alex: arm64 failure looks like unrelated flakiness from a timing assertion. Rerunning job now.

sam: After both approvals + CI green, can we merge once RFC page is updated to "Accepted (design-reviewed)" and add a release note? I can update RFC if maya is busy.

maya: I'll update the RFC status once alex gives final approval. If anyone hits merge blockers (rebase conflicts or flaky arm64), ping me and I can take the merge. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
